name: 9333-codeedit-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One 8B target on one card.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 400 requests with a 900 s safety cap, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, seed 9333, prompt EXACTLY 550 tokens and output EXACTLY 150 (min = max), greedy at temperature 0.0, ignore_eos forced by max_tokens. `request_format: "plain"` is a HARD REQUIREMENT at this engine: the templated path calls `apply_chat_template` on a `BaseTokenizerGroup`, which has no such method and would raise at request time; plain mode also puts the prompt on the wire at exactly its declared 550 tokens.
purpose: A code-editing helper for developers, serving eight concurrent users short 8B-model edits on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.6.3-line engine, commit 5b8a1fde84224e24ec121e0dc149d775330d911b.
# AsyncEngineArgs of this era: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do
# not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# `[ngram]` is the literal sentinel the engine looks for, and it MUST stay a quoted string:
# unquoted, the flat config reader tries to read it as a JSON list.
speculative-model: "[ngram]"
num-speculative-tokens: 5
ngram-prompt-lookup-max: 4

# Engine requirements at this commit: SpeculativeConfig refuses to build without the V2 block
# manager, and raises if chunked prefill is on. Both are the defaults here; pinned anyway.
use-v2-block-manager: true
enable-chunked-prefill: false

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
